title: Quiet money (batch 6): quiet data/AI founders + foreign family-office fortunes
source: Public record: company histories; Forbes/Bloomberg; SEC/regulatory filings; DeepSeek/High-Flyer + ByteDance reporting. Catalog layer (#242 batch 6). Structural overlay; person nodes carry dossiers. FOCUS: low-profile founders of data/AI powerhouses + quiet foreign (China/Israel/Europe) family fortunes moving through tech. HONESTY: holdings/ownership = fact; influence graded; no cabal imputed.

edges.notes: Liang Wenfeng founded High-Flyer - a Chinese quant hedge fund (~$8B) that amassed a huge Nvidia-GPU cluster; the quant-finance base that funded his AI pivot (fact).

Liang spun DeepSeek out of High-Flyer; its efficient open-weight models (R1, Jan-2026 wave) shocked the market + reframed the US-China AI + compute-cost race - a quiet quant funding a frontier lab (fact); mirrors the RenTech/Two Sigma quant-to-data pattern in China.
High-Flyer stockpiled GPUs + compute pre-export-controls - the quant-fund-to-AI-infra move that made DeepSeek possible (fact).

Zhang Yiming founded ByteDance (TikTok/Douyin/Toutiao) - the recommendation-algorithm + data powerhouse; stepped back as CEO/chair (2021) but remains the controlling shareholder + China's richest, keeping a very low profile (fact).

ByteDance's algorithmic behavioral-data engine (TikTok) is the surveillance-advertising analog at planetary scale - the center of the US TikTok-ban/data-security fight (fact of data scale; national-security framing graded).

Idan Ofer - Israel's richest (Ofer shipping dynasty) - controls Israel Corp / Kenon (shipping, chemicals ICL, power, and EV/tech bets like Better Place legacy + IC stakes); quiet, globe-spanning (fact).
The Ofer family (Idan + brother Eyal, shipping/real-estate) are among Israel's most powerful, low-profile business dynasties - shipping being strategically sensitive (fact).

Anders Holch Povlsen - Denmark's richest (Bestseller fast-fashion) - is also a major tech VC (early/large stakes in Klarna, Zalando, and others) + Scotland's largest private landowner; very low profile (fact).
Via Heartland, Povlsen is a large Klarna shareholder - retail-fashion cash into fintech/BNPL (fact); wires quiet European money to the fintech thread.
Klaus-Michael Kuehne - the reclusive controller of Kuehne+Nagel (the world's largest sea-freight forwarder) + big Hapag-Lloyd/Lufthansa stakes - quiet control of critical global logistics (fact).
Guillaume Pousaz - the low-profile Swiss founder of Checkout.com (payments) - once Europe's most valuable fintech (~$40B peak); quiet payments-rail wealth (fact; valuation since cut).
Rich Barton - serial founder of data-driven marketplaces (Expedia, Zillow, Glassdoor) built on the 'power to the people via data' thesis - the US data-marketplace archetype (fact).
Zillow's real-estate data (Zestimate; the failed iBuying 'Zillow Offers') exemplifies consumer-data-as-product + the perils of data-driven pricing - adjacent to the broker ecosystem (fact).
DeepSeek's rise made Liang a state-celebrated figure (met by Chinese leadership) - the quiet quant now a symbol of China's AI self-sufficiency drive (fact).
DeepSeek anchors the efficient/open-weight pole of the AI race - wiring the quiet-money layer to the China-AI + AI-bubble threads (fact).
